description.value: Glory Juice Co. is a certified-organic cold-pressed juice bar located in Vancouver's cycling-friendly Olympic Village neighborhood. The flagship cafe specializes in cold-pressed juices, wellness shots, smoothies, and multi-day cleanse programs, all made from fully disclosed organic ingredients. It is one of over 100 retail points for the Glory brand across the Pacific Northwest, making it a recognizable refueling landmark for touring cyclists.

bike_parking_detail: 7 racks within 100m: rack (6 spaces) at 35m; rack (4 spaces) at 46m; rack (21 spaces) at 46m; rack (20 spaces, covered) at 55m; rack (42 spaces, covered) at 62m; rack at 83m; stands (8 spaces) at 83m. Total: 101 spaces.

No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or charging anywhere on the site, so those fields remain null.
